blocks.text: 第 10 章 文件和异常
本节学习：第 10 章 文件和异常。讲义保留原有示例与练习，可结合正文向教师提问。

```python
with open("note.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

with open("note.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("Hello\n")

try:
    result = 10 / int(input("除数："))
except ZeroDivisionError:
    print("不能除 0")
else:
    print(result)

import json
with open("data.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump([1, 2, 3], f)
```
